entries.actual_author: NOT originated by Nicholas of Cusa
entries.work: ancestor: pseudo-Hermetic Liber XXIV Philosophorum (12th c.) - 'DEUS EST SPHAERA INFINITA CUIUS CENTRUM EST UBIQUE, CIRCUMFERENTIA NUSQUAM'
entries.bibliography_relationship: MISSING - no Cusa entry in Ch2
entries.notes: Audit: EVOLVED APHORISM / RECOVERABLE ANCESTOR. Cusa USED the figure (De Docta Ignorantia I.23) but did not originate it; so did Alain de Lille, Bonaventure, Pascal and Voltaire. TWO alterations in the manuscript: sphere changed to circle, and the clause order reversed. Sphaera is the point of the image - infinity in every direction.
